zh.title: 美國空管人員新協議加薪近3%並禁止提早離崗
zh.summary: 美國空管人員新協議加薪近3%，並停止提早離開工作
body: Simple Flying報導，美國空中交通管制員依新協議調薪近3%；標題並指出，協議不允許管制員提早離開工作。來源摘要將這項變化描述為結束長期存在的提早離崗習慣，並將加薪與提早離崗規定列為同一新協議的內容。
摘要另提到強制記錄工時及人力配置調整，並稱這些安排旨在降低風險及加班壓力。來源將降低風險與加班壓力表述為措施的目標，並未聲稱這些結果已經實現。

en.title: US Air Traffic Controllers Get Nearly 3% Pay Rise Under Deal Ending Early Departures
en.summary: US air traffic controllers receive nearly 3% pay rises under a deal ending early departures.
body: Simple Flying reports that a new deal provides US air traffic controllers with a pay increase of nearly 3%. The headline also says the deal does not allow controllers to leave work early, and the summary characterizes this as ending longstanding early-leave habits. The report describes changes to both pay and early departure practices under the same agreement.

The summary additionally identifies mandatory timekeeping and staffing shifts, saying they aim to curb risk and overtime pressures. It presents reduced risk and overtime pressures as objectives of these measures, not as outcomes already achieved.
